intent: A host-city map: the three countries everyone links with the Olympics, the real count once you add the Winter Games, the city pins dropping one by one, and the two already booked.
pacing_profile: question read verbatim, three options, 3-s beat, reveal with the number, story beats shaped per episode (brief.md), punchline + short follow
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).
title: Which country has HOSTED the most Olympic Games?

lines.direction: the question, cold — curiosity comes from the map moving under it
lines.text: Which country has hosted the most Olympic Games?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat
lines.text: France, United Kingdom, or United States?
The United States. 8 Games so far: 4 summer and 4 winter, from Saint Louis to Salt Lake City.

lines.direction: pull back across the Atlantic so all three share the frame; France lights with its tag on 'France', Britain on 'Britain'; the host counter sits at 8 for the US while the others appear
lines.text: France is second with 6 in total, including Paris. Britain has 3, all of them in London.

lines.direction: back onto the US; LA pin pulses on 'Angeles', Salt Lake on 'Salt'; the counter runs 8 → 10 and the happy flag-ball pops on '10'
lines.text: Los Angeles hosts again in 2028, and Salt Lake City returns in 2034. That makes 10.

lines.direction: wide Atlantic again; the THREE-TIME CITIES card lands on 'third'; London and Paris stickers drop on their names, the medal pulses
lines.text: Los Angeles then becomes only the third city ever to host 3 summer Games, after London and Paris.

lines.direction: punchline, then a short follow — the outro visual asks
lines.text: More than you thought. Follow us.
